identity.authorization: Server enforces all tenant, role, project and document access. Client filters are not access control.

EvidenceValue.value: finite number|string|boolean|null; unknown and not applicable require null
EvidenceValue.unit: supported unit or null for categorical value
EvidenceValue.origin: origin enum or null when no source exists
EvidenceValue.period: {start,end,timezone,coverageRatio} or null; energy comparisons require compatible annual periods
EvidenceValue.interval: {lower,upper,kind,methodRef} or null; kind=SCENARIO_RANGE|MODEL_RANGE|MEASUREMENT_RANGE; never invent confidence level

FactorAssessment.explanation: rule-derived structured text, never post-hoc AI reasoning

RequirementCoverage.answeredUnknownFieldIds: subset array; not included in available

SiteGeometry.areaMethod: geodesic or named suitable local projection; never display pixel area

ProjectSnapshot.scoreJobState: IDLE|QUEUED|RUNNING|FAILED|SUCCEEDED; independent of review status during recalculation
ProjectSnapshot.projectSize: EvidenceValue; do not sort/add unlike units

DecisionEvent.primaryReasonCode: one code for rejection, else null

Journey.journeyId: unique measurable visit ID, not a person ID

scoringRules.productionWeightPolicy: Provided by versioned professionally owned profile configuration; example weights must not be enabled as production defaults.
scoringRules.weightsInvariant: Applicable maxPoints sum to exactly 100. N/A excluded by profile, not silently renormalized at render time.
scoringRules.rounding: Service rounds total once to integer, decimal half up; class uses same display integer.
scoringRules.partialPolicy: Unknown contributions remain null. Lower=sum known lower bounds; upper=sum known upper bounds+unknown maxima. No scalar score or class in PARTIAL.
scoringRules.blockerPolicy: Explicit documented gates independent of numeric score; never hidden point deductions.
scoringRules.activeFactorPolicy: Only applicable factors with maxPoints > 0 count in score coverage and PARTIAL. Applicable maxPoints=0 renders Not weighted, never 0/0; information/blocker rules remain independent.

transitionGuards.anyMutation: Authorization + expected revision + idempotency key; server confirms result.
transitionGuards.toREJECTED: Explicit authorized action + primary reason + certainty + event snapshot; not timeout or automatic low-score rule.
transitionGuards.REJECTED_to_PARTNER_REVIEW: Explicit authorized reopen with explanation; retain rejection event.
transitionGuards.SCORING_to_QUALIFIED: Configured prequalification gates satisfied. Suggested starting workflow >=65, complete required basis, no active confirmed blocker; proposal, not validated scoring model.
transitionGuards.INFO_REQUESTED_to_PARTNER_REVIEW: Response confirmed or authorized explicit resumption. Partial answer leaves unmet requirements visible.
transitionGuards.CONTRACTED_to_REALIZED: Confirmed actual milestone; post-contract disturbances use separate events, not retroactive pre-contract loss.

pipeline.age: median current status age of nonterminal projects, not historical throughput time
pipeline.overdue: dueAt exists and is before asOf and action open

funnel.grain: same measurable journey cohort, at most one primary project per journey
funnel.qualifiedStageReach: max(submittedAt, valid qualifiedAt); analytical derived timestamp, not fabricated workflow event
funnel.notReachedNext: N(stage)-N(next) with still open vs closed distinction
funnel.horizon: relative to every journey start, not one arbitrary calendar snapshot
funnel.maturity: all included journeys have elapsed horizon; otherwise visibly provisional
funnel.eventDedup: unique eventId plus stage/project idempotency; never count retries as new reaches

partnerAcceptanceRate.pending: qualified assigned projects without first decision, separate

projectWinRate.denominator: contracted + effective closed pre-contract rejections within the qualified cohort
projectWinRate.pending: qualified projects without effective closed outcome; reopened cases are open

reasons.grain: one effective rejection primary reason per case in stated rejection decision cohort
reasons.secondary: separate many-to-many frequency; sum can exceed 100%
reasons.legacyMissing: explicit uncoded category, never silently OTHER

uiState.backgroundRefresh: at most 60s while visible; preserve current ordering until user accepts new snapshot

validation: sum known contributions agrees with integer score after single rounding
